name: Ash and Blood Server Mod
description:
[h1] Ash & Blood: A Tale of the Exiled[/h1]

[b]Heavy RP * RP-PvP * Conan Exiles UE5 * Season 2[/b]

[i]"Every scar tells a story. Every oath has a price."[/i]

[b]Ash & Blood[/b] is a whitelisted, [b]18+ Heavy RP[/b] server set in a gritty, human-only interpretation of the [b]Hyborian Age[/b].

We've officially moved to [b]UE5[/b] and opened the next chapter of the server:

[h2]Season 2.[/h2]

[hr][/hr] 

[h2] What Makes Ash & Blood Different?[/h2]

We aren't trying to be a server where the strongest clan simply wins.

We're building a world where [b]your character actually matters.[/b]

[b] RP-PvP[/b]
Conflict is earned through roleplay and escalation.

[b] Living World[/b]
Guards, markets, taverns, businesses & player politics.

[b] Economy[/b]
Trade, coin, stipends, merchants & player services.

[b] Consequences[/b]
Injuries, captivity, scars, corruption & recovery.

[b] Sorcery[/b]
Rituals, curses, corruption & forbidden knowledge.

[b] Clans & Politics[/b]
Alliances, rivalries, territory & power struggles.

[b] Crime[/b]
Thievery, disguise, investigation & consequences.

[b] Long-Term RP[/b]
Characters and stories designed to develop over time.

[hr][/hr] 

[h2] Roleplay First[/h2]

[quote][b]Roleplay creates PvP... not the other way around.[/b][/quote]

PvP is part of Ash & Blood, but random aggression isn't the goal.

A disagreement can become a rivalry.

A rivalry can become a feud.

A feud can become a war.

And the consequences can become part of your character's story.

[hr][/hr] 

[h2] A World With Consequences[/h2]

Your character isn't disposable.

[b]Injuries matter.[/b]
[b]Reputation matters.[/b]
[b]Relationships matter.[/b]
[b]Choices matter.[/b]

Healers, alchemists, criminals, guards, merchants, warriors, nobles, priests and sorcerers all have a place in the world.

You don't need to be the strongest character on the server.

You just need [b]a story worth telling.[/b]

[hr][/hr] 

[h2] Season 2 — Now on UE5[/h2]

Season 2 brings a major continuation of Ash & Blood with:

[list]
[*] [b]Conan Exiles UE5[/b]
[*] Reworked server rules
[*] Overhauled sorcery system
[*] Clan & territory systems
[*]️ Guard system overhaul
[*] Reworked conflict & raiding
[*]️ Expanded crime & thievery
[*] Player economy
[*] Expanded lore & wiki
[/list]

[quote][b]A new engine. A new chapter. The same world... still being shaped by its players.[/b][/quote]

[hr][/hr] 

[h2] Who Is Ash & Blood For?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Long-term character development
[*] Text-based roleplay
[*] Conan / Hyborian Age fans
[*] Political & social RP
[*] Organic PvP
[*] Player businesses & professions
[*] Crime & investigation
[*] Dark fantasy & sorcery
[*] People who want their choices to matter
[/list]

[i]You arrive as an Exile.[/i]

[i]What you become is up to you.[/i]

[hr][/hr] 

[h2] Join Us[/h2]

[b]Heavy RP * RP-PvP * Conan Exiles UE5 * Human-Only * Low Fantasy * 18+ OOC[/b]

[i]Come make your mark.[/i]
